allies.rationale_text: Scaffolding supports synthesis-and-integration by connecting smaller units into a larger structure that people can actually hold and use.
allies.affinity_rationale: Canonical describes synthesis as building complex concepts from smaller, simpler units (chunks) through scaffolding
allies.activation_condition: When integrating disparate knowledge requires building up from chunked, scaffolded components

allies.rationale_text: Systems-thinking gives synthesis-and-integration the ability to turn dispersed observations into a coherent picture of interrelationships.
allies.source_quote: Systems thinking explicitly calls for synthesis to see interrelationships rather than static snapshots.
allies.affinity_rationale: Synthesis applies multidisciplinary thinking to weave together disparate knowledge, which supports systemic understanding
allies.activation_condition: When weaving together knowledge from multiple disciplines requires systemic integration

antagonists.rationale_text: Rationalization undermines synthesis-and-integration by processing information toward a desired conclusion, distorting the objective assembly of facts and external perspectives into a coherent whole.
antagonists.source_quote: Motivated reasoning processes information to reach a desired conclusion, actively distorting the objective synthesis of facts and external perspectives (the outside view).
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Canonical describes motivated reasoning as actively distorting objective synthesis by processing information toward desired conclusions
antagonists.activation_condition: When desire for a specific conclusion distorts the objective integration of evidence from multiple sources

structured_tensions.tension_text: Synthesis-and-integration conflicts with decomposition when synthesizing components back together loses the diagnostic precision that decomposition achieved.
structured_tensions.source_quote: synthesis-and-integration conflicts with decomposition (decomposition) when synthesizing components back together loses the diagnostic precision that decomposition achieved.

structured_tensions.tension_text: Synthesis-and-integration conflicts with simplification when integrating multiple frameworks produces a composite that is more complex than any single model and harder to act on.
structured_tensions.source_quote: synthesis-and-integration conflicts with simplification (simplification) when integrating multiple frameworks produces a composite that is more complex than any single model and harder to act on.
